_source: IMAGINED CAPABILITY. No such endpoint exists today.
_note: Imagined capability 2 of 3. Pine Labs holds the merchant relationship with the pharmacy and the authorisation record for every transaction at that counter. The line-item data passes through them; it is simply not returned. Without it the refill clock is computed from the prescription, which is wrong whenever somebody buys only what their cash covers.
